init_locobot_arm: initialize a LoCoBotArm instance with position control mode and moveit planner
set_joint_torque: set torque on a single arm joint by name with a value in Nm
set_ee_pose_pitch_roll: command the robot arm end-effector to a target position with pitch and roll angles
set_joint_torques: set torque values for all four arm joints at once using a list
go_home: command the robot arm to return to its home zero position
